ai_summary: Adroit Industries reported strong Q1 FY27 profitability with 32.13% YoY PAT growth and significant EBITDA margin expansion to 30.93%, driven by operational efficiencies. The company is actively deploying IPO proceeds for a major CapEx to double manufacturing capacity, entering the defense sector, and strategically diversifying into South American and Canadian markets. A potential concern is the sequential decline in revenue and EBITDA from Q4 FY26, which merits attention as the ambitious expansion and diversification plans progress.
